name: The Land Of Israel
overview: Scripture reveals that the land of Israel is a divine gift promised by God to Abraham and his descendants, as affirmed in Genesis 12 and 15, where God declares His covenant to give the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates. This land is not merely property to be owned but belongs ultimately to the Lord, who reminds His people that they are sojourners on it (Leviticus 25). The Lord also promises restoration, gathering His scattered people back to this land (Ezekiel 11), and calls His people to pray for the peace of Jerusalem, linking their prosperity to the city’s well-being (Psalms 122). God's blessing upon those who bless His people underscores the land's central role in His redemptive plan, culminating in the blessing of all families of the earth through Abraham’s seed (Genesis 12).
